name: walkie
description: Search and read your recorded meetings — notes, action items, participants, and speaker-labeled transcripts.
long_description: Walkie records and transcribes your meetings on your computer. This extension lets Claude search across everything you've said or heard and pull any meeting's notes, action items, participants, and speaker-labeled transcript — all read-only. It runs Walkie's local MCP server (`walkie --mcp-serve`), which reads Walkie's local database and sends nothing anywhere itself.

tools.name: search_meetings
tools.description: Search across your recorded meetings by keyword

tools.name: get_meeting
tools.description: Read a meeting's notes, action items, participants, and transcript

tools.name: list_meetings
tools.description: Enumerate meetings as metadata (requires full archive access)
